impact.text: an incorrect totalSupply() will be used for fee accrual, leading to incorrect fee accrual.

precondition_sources.text: A user transfer/transferFrom action is executed such that _claimRewards() is invoked atomically through the _update hook.
SiloVault accrues fees from interests (delta totalAssets) via _accrueFee(), which mints additional shares to the fee receiver.

intent_sources.text: Before _claimRewards() is invoked, _accrueFee() (or _updateLastTotalAssets(_accrueFee())) should be called so that totalSupply() is synced for fee accrual.
